strongestInEvidence: The strongest strategy is to sell per-listing drone photo/video packages directly to Phoenix listing agents at about $200-250. Prices are evidenced by PropPhoto's $129-300 drone shoot / $100-300 add-on (Q2, Q26) and Fullview's $249 Phoenix package with drone angles (Q24). Demand: 27,427 active listings and 5,155 monthly closings (Q1), with 52% of agents using drone media (Q4). Sell through three channels at once. (1) The ARMLS Preferred Photographer Program, free until Jan 2027 after a training quiz (F22, Q21). (2) A free PropPhoto listing, where only 9 drone photographers are listed in AZ (Q21/Q24). (3) Direct outreach to listing agents found in the MLS (Q30), with Facebook lead ads at about $13.74 real-estate CPL (F19): roughly $400-600 buys 30-40 leads. Fly with $1M liability insurance, which real-estate and construction clients require (F25), at $62/mo or $14/hr. Collect payment at the shoot (Q3). Fill spare hours with Zeitview/FlyGuys/Droners missions ($125-225 real estate, $300-500 construction mapping; F28, Q22), discounted for 20-50% claim rates and 40% weather cancellations (F2/F4). Optionally add construction progress documentation, framed as not a survey to stay clear of A.R.S. 32-101/32-145 (F12). About 20-25 agent jobs at $200-250 (40-60 h) plus a few network missions reaches $4,500 net of roughly $700 in ads and insurance, well inside 171 h and $1,500.
